```python
# High-level on-device adaptation using MAML-style optimization
def adapt_on_device(model, new_frames, num_shots=5):
    \"\"\"Perform 5-shot adaptation on edge device.\"\"\"
    adapted_model = copy.deepcopy(model)
    support_set = new_frames[:num_shots]
    
    for step in range(adapter_steps):
        loss = compute_meta_loss(adapted_model, support_set)
        grads = torch.autograd.grad(loss, adapted_model.parameters())
        adapted_model = apply_gradients(adapted_model, grads, lr=adapt_lr)
    
    return adapted_model
```

## Why This Is Asked
This question probes practical monocular 3D pose estimation in a human-robot collaboration setting with occlusions and quick adaptation to new PPE and tools, reflecting real-world constraints on edge devices.

## Key Concepts
- Monocular 3D pose for multiple agents
- Interaction-aware reasoning and contact constraints
- Temporal tracking with short windows
- On-device adaptation via adapters or meta-learning
- Synthetic+real data fusion and occlusion handling

## Code Example
```javascript
function poseLoss(pred, gt){
  // 3D keypoint L2 loss with visibility masking
  const diff = pred.keypoints.filter(v => v.visible).map((p,i)=>p - gt.keypoints[i]);
  return diff.reduce((a,b)=>a+b*b, 0);
}
```
